description: Verifies the Bardeen shadow of the Kerr metric: the area of the Schwarzschild shadow against pi times 27 M^2, and the overlap ratio of the computed boundary with the analytic curve for spins from 0 to 0.9999 and inclinations of 17 and 90 degrees.

checks.label: the shadow area equals 27 pi M^2 within a relative 1e-5
a = 0, inclination 90 deg: the overlap with the analytic shadow exceeds 99.999 percent
a = 0.5, inclination 90 deg: the overlap with the analytic shadow exceeds 99.999 percent
a = 0.9, inclination 90 deg: the overlap with the analytic shadow exceeds 99.999 percent
a = 0.9999, inclination 90 deg: the overlap with the analytic shadow exceeds 99.999 percent
a = 0.9, inclination 17 deg: the overlap with the analytic shadow exceeds 99.999 percent
